claim: Can historical records distinguish parameter changes from changes in roles, authority, transitions, evidence, data or dispositions?
Can the source expose private preferences/reasons and negotiation behavior under controlled conditions?
Can the source support real authority, commitment and target-world effect claims?
Can the source reveal contextual process variants and role/process vocabulary?
Can the source show that real Principals knowingly delegate to an Agent, explain back, accept and retain the result?
extra_required: live agent intervention and prospective consent

claim: Can the source causally estimate net coordination value versus an excellent human broker or central Agent?
Can a mature institutional frame make a complex relation safely collapsible to deterministic or centralized mechanisms?
Can affected-party or expert standing materially alter a relation without conferring signature authority?
Can records distinguish declared governance/integration rules from enacted observation, intervention and assurance capacity?
Can technical/operational adoption coexist with governance, assurance or legitimacy instability?
Can the coordination mechanism vary with autonomy, authority topology and outcome type under a common mandate?
